thread:
kevin_ux: Quick follow-up from today's design review: in-console doc snippets open a modal but don't update the URL. That breaks shared links and onboarding emails.
mina_docs: Reproduced. Docs have stable anchors like #batching but the modal doesn't set fragments.
ryan_fe: Current component opens modal only. Quick fix: read data-anchor on trigger and history.replaceState('#anchor') when opened. Also focus the heading inside modal.
zoe_a11y: Ensure we set tabindex=-1 on the target heading and call el.focus(). Add aria-expanded on the trigger and aria-labelledby on modal.
kevin_ux: Copy inconsistency too: snippets label reads "Guide" while console nav shows "Docs". Recommend standardize to "Docs".
mina_docs: I'll update headings to include stable ids and add a small alias map for legacy anchors.
ryan_fe: I'll submit a small PR with fragment handling + aria attributes + focus trap. Estimate 1d.
ci-bot: CI queued. Docs PR required for stable ids to land before frontend.
zoe_a11y: QA checklist: keyboard flow, screen reader announcement, back button restores focus.
kevin_ux: Thanks — tagging UX for copy signoff once PR is up.
